# InstaTech

> Walk-in phone, tablet, laptop and smartwatch repair in central London. Two shops: Bloomsbury (67 Marchmont Street, WC1N 1AP) and Moorgate (16 City Road, EC1Y 2AA). Open 7 days. Free diagnostic, no fix no fee, warranty on every repair. Most repairs are done the same day, often while you wait. Free Pick & Drop collects and returns devices anywhere in London.

## Locations

### InstaTech Bloomsbury
- Address: 67 Marchmont Street, London WC1N 1AP, United Kingdom
- Nearest stations: Russell Square, King's Cross St Pancras
